notes.title: Update
notes.content: Quick update to fix a problem with scene jumping.  In addition, clearing the persistent data now clears everything used by the WTC series

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Some people have, for unknown reasons, had trouble with Steam achievements.  There is now a Reset Persistent option in Extras that will clear persistent data and achievements and then resync everything.

No idea whether it will help or not, but give it a go !

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
One very quick update : 

Thanks to AlfredPros, I managed to get the music player to work as I originally wanted it to.

In addition, there is one final achievement

notes.title: Update
notes.content: Linux version is finally available on Steam

notes.title: Update
notes.content: Updated Android version

notes.title: Update... again
notes.content:
This should be the very final update, and includes support for Italian and Spanish languages as translated by Daniele Ferrari (thanks !).

It wasn't felt worthwhile to translate the achievements and a few other things, but the main menu and the game have been translated.

In other news, achievements have been added now.

notes.title: A Year On
notes.content:
It's been just over a year now since I released the original test version !

Thanks to Daniele Ferrari, there will be one more update with all the text translated into Spanish and Italian.  This should be out no later than the end of July

notes.title: Update

notes.title: WTC Redux
notes.content: Just to let you know that WTC  Redux is now available !

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
One final update to this test program brings the graphics up to the same as WTC 2 and the upcoming WTC Redux.

This will be the final update now.

notes.title: Believe it or not...
notes.content:
...there will be an update of this (mainly to show off the new backgrounds and characters).

There will also be an Android version soon for this as well (again, as a test).

There will be no change to the story (as that will be covered properly with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/963770/Welcome_To_Chichester_Redux__The_Spy_Of_America_And_The_Long_Vacation/]WTC Redux[/url])

notes.title: Very last update

notes.title: There will be one more update
notes.content: Due to a memory bug in the engine, the program will be updated one final(?) time in the near-ish future.  In addition, an animated logo will be added

notes.title: Welcome To... Chichester 2 is now available
notes.content: WTC 2 is now out on Steam, for a very reasonable price too!

notes.title: Last update
notes.content:
One final update :

* Fix a few grammatical errors
* Add a bit to the story (mainly at the end), to take into account events that will happen in WTC 3
* Tidy a few things up

notes.title: Last update
notes.content:
There will be one last update to take in account various things that happen in WTC 3

It wont extend the gameplay by a large amount.

notes.title: Release date
notes.content: The release date for WTC 2 has been set for 02/08/2018 !

notes.title: Good news - Part #2
notes.content:
The Steamworks process has now been started for Welcome To... Chichester 2.

Continuing from where the first one left off, the protagonist still believes he is in America.  

When he finds out the truth, his whole world falls apart.  

What will it take to get him back up on his feet ? And what secrets are being kept from him ?

This is a much longer story with 7 different endings over 6 routes, and features new characters as well as a returning one.

Should be available by the end of August

notes.title: Good news!
notes.content:
The first sequel is currently being written.  Currently running to 31 pages of script and provisionally titled "The Spy of Chichester and the Eager Tourist Guide".

It has around 5 different endings
